name: activity-replace-false-preserves
description: an ACTIVITY_SNAPSHOT with `replace: false` for an existing activity leaves it as it stands — its content and its activityType both
kill: ignore `replace` in the ACTIVITY_SNAPSHOT branch (`const replace = true`), or apply only the content half of the opt-out and retype the message anyway

dotnet.intentional: The .NET client has no activity reducer: ACTIVITY_SNAPSHOT and ACTIVITY_DELTA reach a consumer only as RawRepresentation on a pass-through update, so no activity-role message is ever materialised and replace:false has nothing to preserve. Alignment tracked separately.
